output.reason: [ev-3f7dccc9a7e0] says the new pure-Protobuf path applies only when `-frontend.encoding=protobuf` is set, so exposure is correctly limited to that flag value. However, the proposed condition compares against the literal "\"protobuf\"", which includes quote characters. That value would never match the actual flag value `protobuf`, so it would miss every exposed environment. The corrected condition uses the plain value "protobuf". The evidence names no other setting that triggers this path.

correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0: when -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, frontend v2 no longer wraps requests and instead sends pure Protobuf via the scheduler to the querier. Environments are exposed when the -frontend.encoding flag equals protobuf.
